goal: Working source-native ANE compiler coverage across models and chips; no GPU or CPU speedup requirement.
implemented_h13: Compile ordinary x[1,K] @ W[K,512] and transposed-weight x[1,K] @ W[512,K]^T without a full-weight transpose allocation.
Validate ANEC package container and binding consistency before dense fp16 buffer conversion.
Pack and unpack physical channel-strided buffers with exact byte-count checks and output overwrite refusal.

verification.orientation_review: ReviewH13Orientation reported no proven bug; dense asymmetric coefficient data was added to strengthen complete-artifact equality coverage.
verification.smoke: Compiler emitted a 4736-byte add package; inspect_anec.py read matching logical shapes, 128-byte logical tensors, and 16384-byte physical allocations.

research_applications.decision: Keep compilation, container inspection, and device execution distinct. Neither inspector asserts that the device executed anything.
Derive encoded command/input/output allocation totals from existing verified metadata; do not label them SRAM usage or total process memory.
Do not infer recurrent-state correctness from layer cosine similarity or introduce approximate INT8 lowering before a numerical contract is established.
Use subtype-5 ISA-11 register evidence for read-only H14 inspection. A register table alone does not establish an executable H14 compiler or M2 runtime.

runtime_prerequisites: Peer retains the base-M1 reservation; last reported boot lacks the ANE device-tree node.
A hardware handoff must identify the live driver/libane revision and the accepted ANEC header and BAR/kernel binding contract.
M2 runtime needs chip-specific firmware, device matching, task-manager and DART evidence plus valid-input numerical verification.
